rows.label: qst700702_msg0001
rows.name:
We're desperately short-handed, so
rubble clearing in the residential and
shopping districts has fallen behind.

rows.label: qst700702_msg0002
rows.name:
We're very grateful for your help,
but, um... I don't want you
to overdo it...

rows.label: qst700702_msg0003
rows.name:
P-Please put your own safety first!
If anything happened to you, we'd have
much bigger problems than rubble!

rows.label: qst700702_msg0004
rows.name:
Please, I beg you,
your safety comes first...!

rows.label: qst700702_msg0101
rows.name:
Oh...! The clearing work
has been completed!?

rows.label: qst700702_msg0102
rows.name:
Thank you so much! Once the garden
is restored, the capital can finally
return to the way it was before!

rows.label: qst700702_msg0103
rows.name:
I'll gather the tools and workers
right away, so could you please tell
the gardener to begin work?

rows.label: qst700702_msg0104
rows.name:
The gardener's name is Bry, and he
is already waiting in this garden.
